notes: «وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ» makes the asker a link (rule 5). The one asked is written as the text has it, «أحدهما» (one of the two Imams), with kind imam_in_text; no previous report is supplied to name him further.
The blessing «عليهما السلام» is not part of the surface. The Quranic citation inside the saying is not a link.
